notes:
Administrators can now choose TV, Movies, Music and Radio separately for each approved Pyakha device using checkboxes in the Device access dashboard.

Disabled sections are hidden from navigation and settings, blocked from shortcuts and playback, and removed from Android TV recommendations. If all sections are disabled, the app shows an access message while keeping Settings and app updates available.

Section access is verified with the device's signed approval and preserved offline until that approval expires. Changes apply when the app returns to the foreground or completes its next access check. Existing devices keep all four sections enabled by default.

This update is required for per-device section controls to take effect.
